entries.title: Ezekiel 35:1
segments: ¶Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:2
segments: Son of man, let your face be turned to Mount Seir, and be a prophet against it,

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:3
segments: And say to it, This is what the Lord has said: See, I am against you, O Mount Seir, and my hand will be stretched out against you, and I will make you a waste and a cause for wonder.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:4
segments: I will make your towns unpeopled and you will be a waste; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:5
segments: Because yours has been a hate without end, and you have given up the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their trouble, in the time of the punishment of the end:

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:6
segments: For this cause, by my life, says the Lord, because you have been sinning through blood, blood will come after you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:7
segments: And I will make Mount Seir a cause for wonder and a waste, cutting off from it all comings and goings.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:8
segments: I will make his mountains full of those who have been put to death; in your valleys and in all your water-streams men will be falling by the sword.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:9
segments: I will make you waste for ever, and your towns will be unpeopled: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:10
segments: ¶Because you have said, The two nations and the two countries are to be mine, and we will take them for our heritage; though the Lord was there:

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:11
segments: For this cause, by my life, says the Lord, I will do to you as you have done in your wrath and in your envy, which you have made clear in your hate for them; and I will make clear to you who I am when you are judged by me.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:12
segments: And you will see that I the Lord have had knowledge of all the bitter things which you have said against the mountains of Israel, saying, They have been made waste, they are given to us to take for our heritage.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:13
segments: And you have made yourselves great against me with your mouths, increasing your words against me; and it has come to my ears.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:14
segments: This is what the Lord has said: Because you were glad over my land when it was a waste, so will I do to you:

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:15
segments: You will become a waste, O Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
